purpose: third-line re-audit of published K1226 (n7 k8 bounded census 331 leaders + n7/n8 k8/k9 witnesses/tampers) and K1224 (n7 k7 catalog 16 configs / 2 orbits). No new mathematical claims.
environment: Mistral TS sandbox on run_typescript; no Node.js/Python; inputs fetched via github_app.get_file_contents; deterministic integer arithmetic (all intermediate values below 2^53); no randomness; core audit executed 3 times this session (2 pre-compaction + 1 post-compaction) with identical results; supplement (n8 trips/dirs, n7 tamper published match, negative control) once.

method.forbiddenQuad: integer 4x4 determinant det[[x^2+y^2,x,y,1]x4]=0 over all C(n^2,4) quadruples (concyclic or collinear), independent implementation of the published convention
method.safe: no forbidden quad among all C(k,4) stone subsets
method.maximal: every empty cell c is blocked: c + some 3-stone subset forms a forbidden quad; uncovered = count of unblocked empty cells (maximal iff 0)
method.orbit: D4 group generated as closure of reflection and 90-degree rotation cell maps; osize = distinct images, stab = fixing maps, indicator lex-min uses 0<1 convention
method.trips: number of collinear 3-subsets; dirs = number of distinct directions (gcd-normalized, undirected) among them

results.F_anchors: F5..F7 match published anchors (826/2491/6364); F8=14564 matches determinism.json n8k9 encoding.F (same value, no novelty); F3/F4 match published forbidgen calibrations (14/194)

census8.perLeaderChecks: all fields {safe,maximal,nViol,nUnc,lexmin,dup,osize,stab,trips,dirs} equal published verify_census8_partial.json for every i=0..330; mismatch count 0

n7k8_tamper.publishedMatch: exactly equal to published tamper_k8_summary.json uncovered_counts (blob c578f312...)

tamperShot1.publishedMatch: exactly equal to published tamper_n8k9_summary.json per-removal values

tamperShot2.note: no published per-stone counterpart (determinism.json records shot1 only); recorded as new data consistent with published all-SAFE/NOT-MAXIMAL claim

negativeControl.description: deliberately wrong D4-free map (n8-style reflection applied to n7) produces off-board images (y=7 row) and a degenerate closure (2 distinct sets) vs correct orbit size 8; any leader would fail the osize/in-board gates
negativeControl.preCompactionIncident: an execution variant with the wrong reflection on n7 failed the orbit gate and was detected via published-value mismatch; result discarded and re-run corrected -- recorded as evidence of gate discriminative power

verdict: ALL-MATCH (every recomputed quantity consistent with the published records; no discrepancy found)
nonClaims: census completeness is untouched: the n7 k8 row orbit count remains >= 331 (publication explicitly does not claim spanning)
no upper bounds for M_7/M_8; n8 k9 census untouched (>= 2 orbits)
this is a finite re-verification, not a formal proof; it does not modify K1224/K1226 items or knowledge README
run_typescript sandbox is not Node.js; wall-clock timings were not recorded (irrelevant to correctness)
